outcome_definitions.acquired_verified: paired home and away value persisted
outcome_definitions.ambiguous_match_rejected: multiple provider matches fitted equally well; refused
outcome_definitions.evidence_missing_request_not_attempted: day listing or match payload absent from cache; absence of a match is not established
outcome_definitions.no_provider_match: a cached day listing was read and holds no eligible match
outcome_definitions.provider_does_not_supply_field: cached payload has statistics but no key for this field
outcome_definitions.provider_no_discipline_block: cached payload has statistics but no cards group
outcome_definitions.provider_no_statistics_block: matched provider fixture has no statistics block
outcome_definitions.provider_predates_xg_era: season predates the provider's 2020/21 xG coverage
outcome_definitions.provider_value_missing_in_payload: key present but no usable numeric value

xg_era_rule: season start year < 2020; measured: 2019 season 27/3,794 with xG (12/1,059 in Jan-Jun 2020) vs 2020 season 3,416/3,878
